systems.system: electronic system for entering registry office documents (unnamed)
systems.owner: Provincial Directorate of Justice and Labor, Nampula, with the Provincial Statistics Delegation
systems.tiers: staff of all registry offices in Nampula province being trained to enter documents; technical teams in the districts digitising existing records; Nampula Civil Registry Office holds documents from 1930

note: The document describes transposing existing physical records into digital form to preserve them (archive class), not the digital registration of a birth or death when declared; so no fact. The system is unnamed and the entry of new events is not stated either way.
